data.content:

## [Website Description Incorrect, Quality Poor](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a00c6380d2ad9f5b4a40830)
The item is described as 100% wool, yet when it arrived the label stated it was 80% wool. Quality is poor overall. Very disappoined.

May 5, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

May 11, 2026

Hi,

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience regarding the quality of the rug swatch you received. I can confirm that the rug is indeed 100% wool, but I understand how disappointing it can be when expectations aren't met. If you would like to return the rug swatch, we would be happy to assist you with a free return. Please let us know how you would like to proceed, we are here to help!

Lulu and Georgia
